title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ojt7: fuzz target not updated for Fragment::from_bytes signature change
description:
## Bug
The commit efb5d298 only updated tests/fragmentation.rs but missed the fuzz target.

## Location
`rust/lichen-schc/fuzz/fuzz_targets/fuzz_fragment.rs:8`

## Problem
`Fragment::from_bytes(data, &mut tile)` uses the old two-argument signature. The function was changed to single-argument `from_bytes(data: &[u8])`. The fuzz target will not compile.

## Fix
Change line 8 to `let _ = Fragment::from_bytes(data);` and remove the now-unused `let mut tile` on line 7.
